```{r}
pacman::p_load(Ipaper, data.table, dplyr, lubridate, stringr, zeallot)
devtools::load_all(".")

find_met <- function(dir_root) {
  fs = dir2(dir_root, "_Met_")
  fs[grep("_(日|Day)", basename(fs))]
}

pattern_met = "_Met_[日|(Day)]"
```

## EBF （5个站点）

```{r}
dir_root = "data-raw/ALL/ChinaFlux_EBF_哀牢山_EBF-2009-2013/"

SITE = "哀牢山"
VegType = "EBF"
VegName = "亚热带常绿阔叶林"

```

> 燕山
```{r}
f_met = "data-raw/ALL/燕山-山地丘陵区_2020-2021/燕山灌丛_Met_日_2020_2021.csv" # 共用一个met
# code(dirname(f_met))
SITE = "燕山"

VegType = "WSA"
VegName = "灌丛" # 山地灌丛, 荆条 + 扁担杆
# z_canopy = 1.7
f_flux = "data-raw/ALL/燕山-山地丘陵区_2020-2021/燕山灌丛_Flux_日_2020_2021.csv" # z_tower = 30m
merge_daily_FluxMet(f_met, SITE, VegType, VegName, f_flux = f_flux)

VegType = "MF"
VegName = "乔灌混交林" # 油松 + 荆条
# z_canopy = 1.7 ~ 11
f_flux = "data-raw/ALL/燕山-山地丘陵区_2020-2021/燕山乔灌混交林_Flux_日_2020_2021.csv" # z_tower = 15m
merge_daily_FluxMet(f_met, SITE, VegType, VegName, f_flux = f_flux)

VegType = "ENF"
VegName = "人工针叶林" # 油松 + 侧柏
# z_canopy = 8 ~ 11
f_flux = "data-raw/ALL/燕山-山地丘陵区_2020-2021/燕山人工针叶林_Flux_日_2020_2021.csv" # z_tower = 20m
merge_daily_FluxMet(f_met, SITE, VegType, VegName, f_flux = f_flux)
```
